blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Automatic CAD generation is commonly evaluated with volumetric IoU, Chamfer Distance, and surface F-score, which barely penalize local errors that occupy only a small fraction of a part's volume or surface area, such as a misplaced hole or a slot on the wrong face, even though such errors are critical to manufacturing. We formalize these metrics in a unified integral form and show that the weight of a local error decays as the $(k+q)$-th power of its size, where $k$ is the dimension of the integration domain and $q$ is determined by the penalty function. Guided by this analysis, we propose DrawScore, which projects both models into three orthographic views with visible and hidden lines, as in engineering drawings, and applies a saturating penalty along the projected curves, so that the weight of a local error decays only linearly. Controlled experiments confirm the predicted decay orders, and on outputs of existing CAD generation agents, DrawScore exposes errors in outputs that IoU rates as nearly perfect. DrawScore further improves generation as a reinforcement learning reward and, for CAD generation from engineering drawings, serves as a test-time verifier without 3D ground truth or an additional reward model. Our code is available at https://github.com/UESTC-Simon/DrawScore.
blocks.zh: 自动 CAD 生成通常用量子IoU,Chamfer距离和表面F-core来评价,它们几乎不会惩罚仅占据一部分体积或表面面积的一小部分的局部错误,例如错误的孔或错误面上的插槽,尽管这些错误对制造至关重要. 我们以统一的整体形式使这些衡量标准正规化,并表明当地误差的权重作为大小的$(k+q)-th的功率衰减,其中$(k$)是整合域的维度,$q$由罚局函数决定. 在这项分析的指导下,我们提出DrawScore,它将两种模型都投射成具有可见和隐藏线条的三种正图视图,如在工程图画中,并在预测的曲线上应用饱和度的判罚,这样一个局部误差的重量只能线性衰减. 被控制的实验证实了预测的衰变命令,在现有的CAD生成剂的输出上,DrawScore暴露出IoU评分的输出错误几乎是完美的. DrawScore进一步改善了作为强化学习奖励的生成,对于来自工程图纸的CAD一代来说,它充当测试时间验证器,没有3D地面真实性或附加奖励模型. 我们的代码可在https://github.com/ULEC-Simon/DrawScore上查阅。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Computer-aided design (CAD) models are the starting point for manufacturing almost every part.
With the widespread adoption of large language models and coding agents, automatic CAD generation has become an active research direction [ 9 , 10 ] .
In CAD generation, a reliable evaluation metric can both identify errors and serve directly as a reward to improve generation [ 9 ] . 1 1 1 A detailed discussion of related work is provided in Section 6 . However, commonly used CAD geometric similarity metrics, including volumetric IoU [ 20 ] , Chamfer Distance [ 7 ] , surface F-score [ 24 ] , and Edge Chamfer Distance [ 4 ] , measure differences over a part’s volume, surface, or sharp edges.
These metrics respond strongly when a part’s overall size or shape is wrong, but give little weight to a missing or misplaced small feature, such as a hole or a slot, even though such errors matter for manufacturing.
blocks.zh:
计算机辅助设计(CAD)模型是制造几乎每个部分的起点.
随着大语言模型和编码剂的广泛采用,自动CAD生成成为了积极的研究方向[9,10].
在CAD生成中,一个可靠的评价衡量尺度既可以识别出错误,也可以直接起到奖励作用来改进生成[9]. 1 1 1 第6节详细讨论了有关工作。 但是,常用的CAD几何相似度测量,包括体积IoU[20],Chamfer距离[7],表面F分数[24],以及Edge Chamfer距离[4],测量某一部分体积、表面或尖锐边缘的差异。
这些衡量标准在某一部分的整体大小或形状出错时反应强烈,但对一个缺失或错位的小特征,例如孔口或插槽,却很少给予分量,尽管这些错误对制造很重要.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Comparison of two candidate CAD models generated by an existing CAD generation agent against the ground truth.
blocks.zh: 图1:现有CAD生成代理生成的两个候选CAD模型对照地心真伪进行比较.

blocks.en:
Figure 1 illustrates how different metrics capture different aspects of geometric error.
Candidate A moves the two slots from the inclined top face to the right side face, whereas candidate B only reverses the profile of one slot.
Although candidate B is clearly closer to the ground truth, the two candidates receive similar IoU scores.
This is because IoU measures how much two solids overlap in volume.
Since the slots occupy only a small fraction of the part’s volume, placing them on the wrong face changes the overlapping volume only slightly.
Surface-based metrics such as Chamfer Distance capture another aspect, namely how far the surfaces deviate, and likewise give little weight to errors on small surface areas.
In engineering drawings, the two errors above appear very differently: the error of candidate A changes the slot outlines in two views, whereas that of candidate B is confined to a small local region.
blocks.zh:
图1说明了不同度量衡如何捕捉几何误差的不同方面.
候选人 A将两个插槽从倾斜上相移到右侧相,而候选人B只倒置一个插槽的剖面.
候选人 B显然更接近地面真相,两位候选人获得相似的IoU分数.
这是因为IoU测量出两种固体在体积上重叠了多少.
由于插槽只占据了部分体积的一小部分,将它们放入错误的面孔只会稍微地改变重叠体积.
诸如Chamfer District 之类的地表测量法捕捉到另一个方面,即地表偏差多远,同样对小地表地区的出错也不太重视。
在工程图纸中,上述两个错误显得非常不同:候选人A的错误在两种观点中改变了时间档大纲,而候选人B的错误仅限于一个小的局部地区.

blocks.en:
This example motivates us to evaluate CAD models through engineering drawings.
❶ Engineering drawings align with how engineers inspect CAD models. After completing a model, engineers typically project it back into engineering drawings and compare them with the design drawings to identify errors.
Three orthographic views with hidden lines are the standard way to convey the geometry of a mechanical part [ 5 , 11 ] , so comparing these views captures most geometric differences between two models.
❷ Engineering drawings capture a different aspect of geometric error. A small feature such as a slot occupies little volume or surface area but still leaves complete lines in the drawings, where its errors stand out.
We explain this difference through an integration dimension analysis in Section 2 : volumetric and surface metrics integrate over 3D solids and 2D surfaces, respectively, whereas comparison through engineering drawings integrates over 1D projected curves.
Unlike the sharp edges of Edge Chamfer Distance, our curves are projected from the entire model and thus include smooth contours.
❸ Engineering drawings support test-time scaling (TTS). Drawings are the standard medium for communicating designs in manufacturing [ 11 ] . In CAD generation from drawing [ 11 , 23 , 25 , 21 , 22 , 12 , 17 ] , the input drawing remains available at inference time, allowing direct comparison with a candidate’s projected views without 3D ground truth or an additional trained reward model; the metric can therefore serve as a test-time verifier.
blocks.zh:
这个例子激励我们通过工程图纸来评价CAD模型.
* 工程图纸与工程师检查CAD模型的方式一致。 完成一个模型后,工程师一般将其投放到工程图纸中并和设计图纸进行比较以识别出错误.
三个带有隐藏行的正图视图是传递机械部分[5,11]几何的标准方式,因此比较这些观点可以捕捉出两个模型之间大多数几何差异.
QQ 工程绘图捕捉到几何误差的不同方面. 槽等小特征占用了很少的体积或地表面积,但仍会留下图中完整的行,其出错突出.
我们通过第2节的综合维度分析来解释这一差异:体积测量和地表测量分别结合了3D固体和2D表面,而通过工程图纸进行的比较则结合了1D预测曲线。
与"边缘"(Edge Chamfer District)的尖锐边缘不同,我们的曲线是从整个模型中预测出来的,因此包括平滑轮廓.
QQ工程绘图支持测试时间缩放(TTS). 绘图是制造中交流设计的标准介质[11]. 在CAD一代从 [11, 23, 25, 21, 22, 12, 17] 中,输入图在推想时仍然可用, 允许直接比较候选人的预测观点, 没有3D 底线真实性或额外的训练有素的奖励模式; 因此, 衡量标准可以作为测试时间验证器.

blocks.en:
We therefore propose DrawScore , which projects the candidate and the ground truth into three orthographic views with visible and hidden lines and measures how well their projected curves coincide.
By capturing an aspect of geometric error different from that of existing metrics, DrawScore complements them for a more comprehensive assessment of generated CAD models.
We evaluate DrawScore on controlled samples and outputs from existing CAD generation agents, and use it as a reward for training and a verifier for TTS.
The results show that:
❶ The decay order of each metric agrees with our integration dimension analysis. Experiments on controlled samples confirm that each metric decays at the order determined by its integration domain and penalty function ( Section 2 ).
DrawScore also detects errors that other curve-based metrics miss.
❷ A perfect volume does not imply a correct model, and the remaining errors of existing agents concentrate on small features. Among 1,188 outputs from six agent configurations, 18.9% of those with IoU ≥ 0.95 \geq 0.95 have a DrawScore below 0.95, whereas only 1.2% of those with DrawScore ≥ 0.95 \geq 0.95 have an IoU below 0.95.
Agents thus mostly get the volume right, and the remaining errors lie on the lines of the drawings.
❸ As a reward, DrawScore improves generation quality across metrics. It raises the share of valid outputs from 75.2% to 89.5% and improves every reported metric over the SFT model, whereas the Edge Chamfer Distance reward, which ignores smooth contours, lowers DrawScore.
❹ DrawScore selects candidates at inference time without 3D ground truth. For CAD generation from engineering drawings, selecting the best of N N candidates by their DrawScore against the input drawing outperforms single generation on most metrics, so DrawScore can serve as an inference-time proxy for them.
blocks.zh:
因此,我们提议“DrawScore ” , 将候选人和地面真相投射为三种直观观点, 并用可见和隐蔽的线条和测量它们的预测曲线是否一致。
DrawScore通过捕捉与现有度量衡不同的几何误差的一个方面来补充它们,以便对生成的CAD模型进行更全面的评估.
我们评估现有CAD生成物剂的受控样品和产出的DrawScore,并将其作为培训的奖励和TTS的核查者。
结果显示:
❶ 每个度量的衰减顺序都符合我们的整合层面分析。 对受控样品的实验证实,每个度量衰减按其整合领域和惩罚功能确定的顺序进行(第2节)。
DrawScore还检测出其他以曲线为基础的度量衡错失的错误.
❷ 完美卷并不意味着正确的模型,而现有代理商的剩余错误集中在小特征上. 在6个代理配置的1,188个产出中,有IoU的18.9%为0.95\克0.95,DrawScore低于0.95,而有DrawScore的只有1.2%为0.95\克0.95,IoU低于0.95。
因此,代理人大多得到的音量正确,剩下的出错则在图纸的线上.
❸ 作为一种奖励,DrawScore提高了跨度量衡的生成质量. 它将有效产出的比例从75.2%提高到89.5%,并且比SFT模型改进了每个报告度量,而忽略平滑轮廓的边际Chamfer距离奖励则会降低DrawScore。
QQ DrawScore在推论时选择没有3D地平线真实性的候选人. 对于CAD一代取自工程图纸,用其 DrawScore 选取 N 候选人中最佳的选取者,对照大多数公分量上输入图画超越了单代,因此 DrawScore 可以作为他们的推论时间代用.

blocks.en: 4.1 Research Questions

blocks.en:
RQ1: Does the integration dimension analysis hold? We inject controlled local errors into ground-truth models and test three conclusions of Sec. 2 in turn.
We construct 53 comparisons from 35 such models.
The three conclusions are the decay order k + q k+q of Eq. 4 , the choice of curves in the integration domain, and the saturating penalty.
For the decay order, we scale one error over several sizes and measure how its weight varies with its size; the other two conclusions are each tested by representative errors that isolate one mechanism.

blocks.en: 4.3 Implementation Details

blocks.en:
We register the candidate to the ground truth with the rigid registration of CADGenBench [ 2 ] , using one transform for all three views.
Registration preserves scale, except in RQ3, where we follow Ortho2CAD [ 12 ] and normalize scale for both rewards and evaluation, since the model being trained often gets the scale wrong and would otherwise receive zero reward for every candidate in a training group.
We then project both models with Open CASCADE from a common camera at the center of the ground truth’s bounding box.
To absorb small residual rotations, each view is projected along eight directions around its principal direction, each shifting the projection by less than σ \sigma .
Recall and precision are computed on each projection after merging overlapping curves of the same visibility, and averaged over the eight directions to give R v R_{v} and P v P_{v} .
Discretization, quadrature, and tessellation settings are given in the supplementary material.

blocks.en: 5.3 RQ3: Can DrawScore serve as a training reward that improves generation quality?
blocks.zh: 5.3 RQ3:能绘图 分数作为提高发电质量的培训奖励?

blocks.en:
Setting. We perform supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on 106,220 DeepCAD samples and reinforcement learning on 6,407 Fusion360 [ 26 ] samples, and evaluate on 153 held-out Fusion360 models.
Starting from the SFT checkpoint, we train Qwen3.5-4B with Dr.GRPO [ 16 ] for 400 steps; all runs share the training data and hyperparameters and differ only in the reward.
Besides DrawScore, we select one existing metric per integration dimension as a reward.
blocks.zh:
准备 我们在106 220个深CAD样本上进行监督微调,在6 407个Fusion360 [26]样本上进行强化学习,并对153个被搁置的Fusion360模型进行评价。
从SFT检查站开始,我们用GRPO博士[16]来训练Quen3.5-4B,共400步;所有运行都共享训练数据和超参数,只在奖励上有所不同.
除了DrawScore,我们每个整合层面选择一个现有的衡量标准作为奖励。

blocks.en:
To separate gains in validity from gains in geometry, we also run a two-stage training.
The validity reward checks only whether an output is valid: it is 1 if the generated CadQuery code executes and produces a valid solid, and 0 otherwise.
We split the reinforcement learning data into two disjoint subsets. We train with the validity reward for 200 steps on 3,203 samples, then continue with DrawScore for 200 steps on the remaining 3,204 samples.
Training and reward details are given in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh:
为了将有效性增益与几何学增益区分开来,我们还进行了分两个阶段的培训.
有效性奖励只检查一个输出是否有效:如果生成的 CadQuery 代码执行并生成一个有效的固件,则为 1, 否则为 0 。
我们把强化学习数据分成两个脱节子集。 我们在3,203个样本上训练200步有效奖励,然后在剩余的3,204个样本上继续使用DrawScore200步有效奖励.
培训和奖励详情见补充材料。

Every geometric reward improves validity and its own metric, but rewards differ in how hard they are to learn. Compared with SFT, all four rewards increase the share of valid outputs and improve the metric they optimize.

blocks.en:
Training with DrawScore improves overall geometric quality. With the DrawScore reward, other three metrics also improve over SFT.
In contrast, the ECD reward increases validity but lowers DrawScore below SFT.
Although both are curve metrics, ECD covers only 3D sharp edges and excludes projected contour lines and hidden lines, so the ECD reward gives no signal on these lines.
blocks.zh:
DrawScore培训提高了总体几何质量。 随着"DrawScore"的奖励,其他三个度量衡也比"SFT"有所改进.
相比之下,幼儿发展奖励提高了有效性,但将DrawScore降低到SFT以下.
虽然两者都是曲线度量衡,但幼儿发展只覆盖了3D锐利的边缘并排除了所预测的等距线和隐藏线,因此幼儿发展奖励在这些线上没有给出信号.

The gains do not come from validity alone. Training with the validity reward alone increases validity but lowers surface F-score and DrawScore below SFT.
The model thus tends to produce outputs that execute but are geometrically coarser, and higher validity by itself does not improve geometry.
Continuing training with DrawScore from this checkpoint improves all geometric metrics over the validity checkpoint.

收益不单来自有效性。 仅凭效力奖励就提高效力,但将表面F-分数和DrawScore低于SFT。

blocks.en: 5.4 RQ4: Can DrawScore improve generation quality at inference time?
blocks.zh: 5.4 RQ4:能绘图 在推断时间分数提高生成质量?

blocks.en:
Setting. The Ortho2CAD samples used in RQ2 are relatively simple: the mean IoU of every configuration lies between 0.926 and 0.967, and multiple outputs of the same model differ little, which makes it hard to test selection.
We therefore use the harder BenchCAD [ 1 ] and perform best-of-N selection on its 20 valid Public T1 cases.
Qwen3.8-max with the codex framework generates 8 candidates for each case, and DrawScore compares each candidate with the input drawing and selects the one with the highest score.
We simulate the input drawing with vector projections of the ground truth in the three orthographic views.
As the baseline, we use the mean over valid candidates, i.e., single-generation performance averaged over sampling; as the upper bound (Oracle), we select the best candidate under each metric using the ground truth.
blocks.zh:
准备 RQ2中使用的Ortho2CAD样本相对简单:每个构型的平均IoU位于0.926至0.967之间,同型号的多出输出相差不大,因此难以测试选择.
因此,我们使用更硬的PeachCAD[1],并在其20个有效的公共T1案件中进行最佳N选择。
带有codex框架的Wen3.8-max为每个案例生成8个入选者,DrawScore将每个入选者与输入绘图进行比较,并选择得分最高的入选者.
我们模拟输入图 与矢量预测 地面真相 在三种正图视图。
作为基线,我们使用平均优于有效候选人,即单代业绩平均高于采样;作为上限(Oracle),我们利用地面真相,在每个衡量标准下选择最佳候选人。

blocks.en: Table 3 : Best-of-N selection with DrawScore (RQ4).
blocks.zh: 表3:使用DrawScore(RQ4)选取的N最佳.

blocks.en: Results. Tab. 3 reports the results of the three strategies.
blocks.zh: 结果。 Tab.3报告了三项战略的结果。

blocks.en:
DrawScore serves as a proxy for other metrics. Without 3D ground truth at inference time, other metrics cannot be used for selection directly; using them would require training additional reward models to predict them.
Selecting with DrawScore outperforms the baseline on most metrics: on IoU, CD, and surface F-score, its gains over the baseline reach 4.7%, 17.2%, and 13.0% of the Oracle’s gains, respectively.
By comparing candidates only with the input drawing, DrawScore thus serves as a proxy for these metrics and removes the need to train reward models for them.
blocks.zh:
DrawScore作为其他度量衡的代名词. 如果没有推断时间的3D地基真理,其他的度量衡无法被直接用于选择;使用这些度量衡将需要训练额外的奖励模型来预测.
使用 DrawScore 选择比大多数衡量标准(IoU、CD和地表F-core)的基线要好,其比基线的收益分别达到4.7%、17.2%和13.0%。
DrawScore通过仅将考生与输入图作比较,从而成为这些度量衡的代名词,并消除了培训奖励模型的必要性.

blocks.en: ✎ Answer to RQ4: Given a vector input drawing, best-of-N selection with DrawScore outperforms single generation on most metrics, without 3D ground truth or an additional reward model.
blocks.zh: QQ 对 RQ4 的回答:鉴于向量输入绘图,DrawScore最优选取N在大多数度量衡上都超越了单代,没有3D地面真假或附加奖励模型.

blocks.en: 6 Related Work
blocks.zh: 6 相关工作

blocks.en:
3D reconstruction is commonly evaluated with volumetric IoU [ 20 ] , Chamfer Distance and Earth Mover’s Distance [ 7 ] , surface F-score [ 24 ] , and normal consistency [ 20 ] .
SAUCD [ 18 ] compares meshes in the spectral domain with frequency-band weights learned from human ratings, and Light Field Descriptor [ 3 ] compares contour descriptors from multiple projected views.
In CAD generation, SECAD-Net [ 14 ] and SfmCAD [ 13 ] use Edge Chamfer Distance, which samples only sharp edges, and IterCAD [ 10 ] aggregates success rates over multiple Chamfer Distance thresholds.
Our analysis in Section 2 unifies these metrics.
Building on it, DrawScore integrates along projected curves in engineering drawings, so the weight of a local error decays only linearly with its size.
blocks.zh:
3D重建通常通过体积IoU[20]、Chamfer距离和地动器的距离[7]、表面F分数[24]和正常一致性[20]来评估。
SAUCD [18] 将光谱域中的 meshes 与从人类评级中吸取的频带分量进行比较,而光场描述 [3] 将轮廓描述符从多个预测视图中进行比较.
在CAD一代中,SECAD-Net [14]和SfmCAD [13] 使用Edge Chamfer距离(Edge Chamfer District),它只取出尖锐的边缘样本,而IterCAD [10] 在多个Chamfer距离阈值上汇总了成功率.
我们在第二节的分析 统一了这些衡量标准。
在此基础上,DrawScore在工程图中将所预测的曲线相接而成,因此一个局部误差的分量仅会随其大小而呈线性衰减.

blocks.en:
Other criteria evaluate properties beyond shape similarity.
DeepCAD [ 27 ] , TransCAD [ 6 ] , and CadVLM [ 28 ] compare generated modeling commands, parameters, or sketch entities with the ground-truth program.
CAD-MLLM [ 29 ] checks geometric validity such as mesh connectivity and self-intersections, CADTests [ 19 ] verifies geometric and topological requirements with sample-specific executable tests, and CADGenBench [ 2 ] combines shape similarity with topology and mating-interface matches.
These criteria complement geometric similarity metrics.
blocks.zh:
其他标准评价超出形状相似性的属性.
DeepCAD [27], TransCAD [6],和 CadVLM [28] 比较生成的建模命令,参数,或草图实体与地-真实程序.
CAD-MLM [29] 检查几何有效性,如网格连通和自相接,CADTests [19] 核查几何和地貌要求,并进行特定样本可执行测试,CADGen Bench [2] 结合了形状相似性与地貌和相交相配.
这些标准补充了几何相似度测量.

blocks.en: 7.1 Sensitivity to the Tolerance
blocks.zh: 7.1 对容忍的敏感性

blocks.en: DrawScore has one hyperparameter, the positional tolerance σ \sigma . We vary it twentyfold, from 0.001 ​ L 0.001L to 0.02 ​ L 0.02L , together with the cone of angular averaging that it determines ( Sec. 4.3 ), and recompute the decay order on the blind-hole sweep of RQ1 and DrawScore on the 1,188 agent outputs of RQ2 at each tolerance ( Fig. 6 ).

blocks.en: On the controlled samples, the fitted decay order of DrawScore stays between 0.96 and 0.97 at every tolerance, close to the order k + q = 1 k+q=1 in the integration dimension analysis. The weight of a local error thus decays linearly with its size, as determined by the integration domain and the saturating penalty rather than by the value of σ \sigma .
blocks.zh: 在受控样品上,DrawScore的装配衰减顺序会在每个容积上停留在0.96到0.97之间,接近整合维度分析中的顺序k + q = 1克+ q = 1. 因此,一个局部错误的分量随其大小而呈线性地衰减,其分量是由集成域和饱和罚则决定的,而不是由\\sigma 的值决定的.

blocks.en:
On the agent outputs, DrawScore at every tolerance correlates strongly with DrawScore at the default σ \sigma (Spearman ρ ≥ 0.84 \rho\geq 0.84 ), so the relative ordering of outputs is largely preserved.
DrawScore is therefore robust to the choice of σ \sigma within this twentyfold range.

关于代理输出,每个容积的 DrawScount 与默认 \\ sigma 的 DrawScount (Spearman ^ 0.84\rho\geq 0.84) 有很强的关联,因此产出的相对顺序基本保持不变。
因此 DrawScore 在此二十倍范围内对 & sigma 的选择很强。

blocks.en:
For a few parts, the three orthographic views do not determine the geometry: internal structures such as stepped bores and internal cavities appear in them only as overlapping hidden lines.
Engineering drawings of such parts include additional section views, and DrawScore can be extended in the same way.

这些部分的工程图纸包括额外的段落视图,DrawScore也可以以同样的方式被扩展.

blocks.en: 7.3 Limitations
blocks.zh: 7.3 限制

blocks.en: The test-time selection of RQ4 assumes that the input drawing is available in vector form; drawings given as raster images would first have to be vectorized. DrawScore also takes longer to compute than other metrics, since it runs hidden-line removal on each model along multiple viewing directions.
blocks.zh: RQ4的测试时间选择假设输入图纸以矢量形式提供;作为光栅图像提供的图纸首先必须被矢量化. DrawScore比起其他度量衡还需要更长的时间来计算,因为它沿着多取景方向在每一个模型上运行隐藏行去除.

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We showed that the weight of a local error in a geometric similarity metric is governed by the dimension of its integration domain and its penalty function. Based on this analysis, DrawScore compares the visible and hidden lines of three orthographic views with a saturating penalty. It exposes errors that existing metrics miss, improves generation as a reinforcement learning reward, and selects candidates at test time without 3D ground truth. Future work will incorporate automatically selected section views to cover internal structures.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,在几何相似度测量中,局部出错的分量取决于其集成域的维度及其判罚功能。 基于这一分析,DrawScore将三种正交视图的可见线和隐藏线与饱和分数比对. 它暴露出现有度量衡错过的错误,改进了生成作为强化学习奖励,并在测试时选择没有3D地基真理的候选人. 今后的工作将包括自动选定的部分意见,以涵盖内部结构。
